verdict.rationale: Inspecting per-result ranking scores or explanations is a fair question for a hosted search engine, so the axis applies. The pack only describes how relevance is configured (searchable attributes, custom ranking, rules, typo tolerance) and which factors Algolia uses to rank. Nothing documents a per-result ranking breakdown or explanation feature.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can inspect ranking scores or explanations to understand exactly why a result ranked where it did
